Buying guide

Planning your custom gift box project

A useful packaging brief connects the product, its journey and the opening experience. Make those decisions first, then compare structures, materials and decoration.

Pricing

What goes into a custom gift box price?

Price follows the specification. Dimensions, construction, print coverage, finishing and packing can change the work involved even when two boxes look similar online.

Order planning

Understanding minimum order quantities

A minimum order is usually tied to a particular custom specification. Discuss the quantity for each size, artwork version and material combination before finalizing your range.

Wholesale

A practical guide to magnetic gift boxes

A magnetic gift box combines a rigid base with a connected cover and a concealed closure. The hinge, front flap and insert need to work together as one structure.

Comparison

Magnetic boxes and lift-off rigid boxes compared

Both formats use rigid board, but the opening action and packing sequence differ. Choose by the product arrangement, the way customers open the pack and the space available for fulfillment.

Read article →
Box structures

Rigid boxes or folding cartons?

A wrapped rigid box and a white-card folding carton are different constructions. Compare material thickness, closure, packing and the role the packaging plays in the complete product system.

Read article →
Packaging ideas

Five ideas for a more memorable unboxing

A considered opening uses a few clear gestures. Arrange the exterior, closure, interior and product information so the user understands what to do next.

Read article →
Materials

Balancing premium presentation and material choices

Start with a suitable structure and a purposeful amount of material. Evaluate the complete pack, including inserts, coatings and closures, before making an environmental statement.

Read article →
Brand experience

Why the feel of a box changes the experience

Weight, texture and the opening gesture all contribute to the way a pack is experienced. Turn those impressions into specific design decisions that can be checked on a sample.

Read article →
Artwork

A clearer process for approving packaging color

Screens help communicate direction, while physical references help approve production. Define the paper, printing method and viewing conditions alongside the intended color.

Read article →
Sourcing

Questions to ask a packaging supplier

Evaluate the supplier against your actual packaging project. A clear specification, relevant documents and a practical sample review are more useful than a general capability claim.

Printed shipping cartons

Specifying a color printed corrugated shipping carton

A printed shipping case needs to communicate the brand and carry the complete shipment. Start with the four-flap construction, then define the board, protection and print scope.

Read article →
Printed corrugated boxes

Planning a full color corrugated mailer and product kit

A die-cut mailer combines presentation with a repeatable packing action. Plan the lid, folded sidewalls, locking flap, insert and artwork together.

Printed white card

Choosing a white card folding carton for retail products

White-card cartons provide a clean printed surface in a folded paperboard structure. The stock, crease, closure and product support all affect the finished result.
